reviews.author: David Hildenbrand
reviews.summary: Identified a double-put bug in fuse_try_move_page() where the folio refcount drops to zero prematurely. Suggested adding an extra folio_get() before replace_page_cache_folio() to maintain the reference.

reviews.author: Zi Yan
reviews.summary: Agreed with David's suggestion to add an extra folio_get() to fix the double-put bug. Also suggested adding a test case for this scenario.

2026-08-07.patch_summary: The patch series improves the coverage of khugepaged selftests by adding new cases and reworking existing ones to better test the collapse mechanism. It includes tests for folio-order detection, order-parameterized collapse cases, and shared-source write races. The patches also scale the collapse wait time with PMD size and fix issues in existing cases.
